functionDeclarations.name: find_supplier
functionDeclarations.description: Resolve the supplier named on the memo to its id. (A bare GET /api/suppliers 405s.) (GET /api/v2/suppliers)

filter[search].description: Supplier name or email from the memo.

functionDeclarations.name: list_vendor_credits
functionDeclarations.description: List vendor credits. Used twice — the duplicate check (by the supplier's credit memo number) and to read how earlier credits from the same supplier were recorded, so the new one matches them. (GET /api/vendor-credits)

filter[vendor_credit_number].description: The supplier's credit memo number, exactly as printed. The duplicate check.

filter[search].description: Free-text over credit number, supplier name and references.

filter[supplier_id].description: Narrow to one supplier's credits (precedent lookup).

functionDeclarations.name: get_vendor_credit
functionDeclarations.description: Full credit with lines (each line's nominal_code_id / nominal_code, cost_impact, description), allocations, totals, remaining_amount and credit_status. (GET /api/vendor-credits/{vendor_credit})

functionDeclarations.name: list_credit_reasons
functionDeclarations.description: The credit reasons (goods_returned, goods_damaged, price_correction, volume_rebate, short_shipped, overpayment, marketing_allowance, services_provided, other), each with its consequence and default cost impact. (GET /api/vendor-credits/credit-reasons)

functionDeclarations.name: find_nominal_code
functionDeclarations.description: Resolve the expense / income account the credit posts against (e.g. "Advertising") to its id. Prefer the account earlier credits from the same supplier used. (GET /api/v2/nominal-codes)

functionDeclarations.name: create_vendor_credit
functionDeclarations.description: Create the credit. Send credit_status "draft" — omitting it creates the credit already OPEN, which posts its accounting immediately and skips the impact preview. (POST /api/vendor-credits)

credit_status.description: draft | open | closed | void. Use "draft"; the model default is open.

vendor_credit_number.description: The supplier's credit memo number, exactly as printed. Unique across the account — a 422 "already used" means the memo is already recorded.

credit_date.description: ISO date. See the instructions on memo date vs. service-period date.

credit_reason.description: A value from list-credit-reasons; it sets each line's default cost_impact.

supplier_reference.description: Any other reference printed on the memo (the bill or invoice it answers).

currency_code.description: Omit for the account currency. Must match any bill it will be allocated to.

vendor_credit_note.description: Free-text note — what the credit is for and what document it answers.

lines.description: Each: { description, quantity (min 1), amount (unit amount, positive), nominal_code_id, is_product: false, cost_impact: "financial_only" }. A line needs description, purchase_order_line_id or financial_line_id.

functionDeclarations.name: preview_cost_impact
functionDeclarations.description: Read-only preview of what authorizing will do: accounts_payable_change, stock and cost basis changes, and touches_closed_period. A financial-only credit should show only an A/P change. (GET /api/vendor-credits/{vendor_credit}/cost-impact)

functionDeclarations.name: authorize_vendor_credit
functionDeclarations.description: Move the draft to open and post its accounting. Reversible with /unauthorize while unallocated. (POST /api/vendor-credits/{vendor_credit}/authorize)

functionDeclarations.name: list_open_bills
functionDeclarations.description: The supplier's bills that still have a balance to apply the credit to. Each row carries outstanding_balance, applied_vendor_credits_total, status and purchase_invoice_date. (GET /api/purchase-invoices)

filter[supplier_id].description: Supplier id. Always send it — without it the list spans every supplier.

functionDeclarations.name: allocate_vendor_credit
functionDeclarations.description: Apply some or all of an open credit to one bill. Same supplier and currency only; amount may not exceed the credit's remaining balance or the bill's outstanding balance. A fully allocated credit closes itself. (POST /api/vendor-credits/{vendor_credit}/allocate)

purchase_invoice_id.description: The bill's id (from list-open-bills) — not its supplier invoice number.

allocated_at.description: Optional ISO date; defaults to now.

functionDeclarations.name: attach_document
functionDeclarations.description: Upload the credit memo as multipart/form-data (field "file"; PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP up to 20 MB). (POST /api/vendor-credits/{vendorCredit}/attachments)
